text: The five most recent Kenya procurement plans in Documents & Reports, by document date (newest first), as of 2026-11-22 (3,711 Kenya procurement plan records in total):
1. 2026-11-10 - Housing Finance, Lands and Sustainable Investments (P513352) - Procurement Plan. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099111026120042234
2. 2026-11-10 - National Agricultural Value Chain Development Project, NAVCDP (P176758) - Procurement Plan. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099111026072522685
3. 2026-11-03 - Housing Finance, Lands and Sustainable Investments (P513352) - Procurement Plan. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099110326151561076
4. 2026-11-02 - Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (P170941) - Procurement Plan. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099110226000538000
5. 2026-10-28 - NAVCDP (P176758) - Procurement Plan (two NAVCDP plans share this date: 099102826015046239 and 099102826042017240).
Procurement plans are updated often, so several entries can be successive versions for the same project.

right_sources: Uses the Kenya country filter and the Procurement Plan document type, sorted by document date descending (not relevance order).
Lists the five newest Kenya procurement plans at run time; as of 2026-11-22 these are the records above.
grounded: Dates, project IDs, project names and links match the records.
complete: Exactly five plans (or five plus a note on a tie), each with date, project and link.
scoped: Makes clear the order is by document date and the list reflects what is disclosed at the time of the search.

notes: Kenya procurement plans are disclosed every few days. If the run is after as_of, the judge should accept the five newest at run time when they are sorted by document date and are Kenya procurement plans; the reviewer can refresh the list.
